applicabilityBasis.summary: pendleUSDC is an ERC-4626 USDC lending-vault share. Its redemption value changes with accrued lending interest and realized strategy losses, and withdrawals depend on available liquidity. It does not establish an issuer obligation to redeem for a fixed amount of national-currency monetary value.

genius.notes: This assessment concerns Pendle Ecosystem USDC at Ethereum:0x55C1B6e461a6334B567bAF0FEb5D728715446f05, independently of underlying USDC. Pendle Ecosystem branding identifies the vault strategy; the opened protocol API and documentation do not establish a legal issuer entity or corporate redemption obligor. issuerEntity is omitted rather than attributing the share to Circle or assuming a curator is its legal issuer. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
